name: Jupiter Wagons Ltd (previously CEBBCO)
tagline: Railway-wagon and rail-mobility maker in an FY26 air-pocket, with wheelset/Europe optionality that only matures from FY28
business_overview: Jupiter Wagons makes freight wagons, brake systems, CV load bodies and containers, and is building a rail-wheel/wheelset business (JV with Tatravagonka; Lucchini RS integrated platform entry). A subsidiary, Jupiter Electric Mobility, does e-CVs and now BESS (110 MWh MoUs). FY26 is a transition year with a wagon-order dry spell.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 2,961 Cr; order book ~Rs 4,675 Cr (~7,000 wagons pending)
~Rs 1,600 Cr for Odisha capex; Rs 403 Cr QIP not yet deployed to capex (CARE flag)
FY27/FY28 'best years' per management; wheelset capacity late 2026/early 2027
fundamentals_narrative: Return ratios have collapsed to ROCE ~9% / ROE ~6% in the FY26 railway-capex air-pocket, yet the stock trades at ~59x earnings — the market is paying up for an FY28 recovery. CARE flagged that Rs 403 Cr of QIP money has seen no capex utilisation. Positives: promoters converted warrants at a ~75% premium to CMP (unusual conviction signal), a 10-year rail-wheel supply pact with Europe's Tatravagonka (supplies from end-2027), and Lucchini RS's entry alongside Jupiter into an integrated wheels/axles/wheelsets platform. Jefferies still prefers Titagarh and sees ~23% downside even after a target hike.
technical_read: Not pulled; stock has de-rated with the railway-capex slowdown.
sentiment_summary: First-time deep read — last ~12 of 234 posts, Dec 2025 to Aug 2026. Sentiment is subdued: FY26 is acknowledged as weak, management explicitly pushes the good years to FY27-28 (wheelset capacity comes 'end 2026 or early 2027', JV breakeven/scale in FY28). Bears cite Jefferies' preference for Titagarh, the CARE QIP-utilisation flag, and slow order inflow. Bulls cite the premium warrant conversion, the Tatravagonka 10-year deal, and the Lucchini RS integrated-platform entry as evidence India can become a wheelset export hub.
community_signal: No trusted-roster users. Non-roster posters antson_m (love 7, on the premium warrant conversion), bbbhutra and vikashkota carried the updates. Balanced-to-cautious.
bull_case: Wheelset/rail-wheel business (Tatravagonka 10-yr pact, Lucchini RS integrated platform) could make Jupiter a structural wheelset exporter from FY28
Promoters converted warrants at ~75% premium to market price — a genuine skin-in-the-game signal
Order book ~Rs 4,675 Cr (~7,000 wagons) provides a revenue floor once execution normalises
Jupiter Electric Mobility adds e-CV + BESS optionality (110 MWh MoUs)
bear_case: ROCE ~9% / ROE ~6% and ~59x P/E — expensive on depressed earnings, with the payoff deferred to FY28
Railway-capex cyclicality; Jefferies prefers Titagarh and still models ~23% downside
CARE flagged Rs 403 Cr QIP funds unused for capex — deployment/execution risk
Legacy 108-screen classed it 'excluded_large'; the wheelset story is real but 2+ years from mattering

value_chain.theme: Railway rolling stock — freight wagons, and (new) rail wheels / wheelsets
value_chain.position: Top-2 Indian private wagon maker; new entrant into rail-wheel/wheelset manufacture with European JV partners
value_chain.bottleneck_node: Forged rail-wheel capacity — India is import-dependent; domestic wheelset capacity is the scarce node Jupiter is building
value_chain.note: The wheelset bottleneck is genuine and the European partnerships are credible, but capacity only comes on-stream late FY27 and scales FY28 — beyond a 2-3 year 10x window.

verdict_headline: Deferred recovery at a rich multiple — 'neither', with wheelset/Europe optionality worth re-checking closer to FY28
verdict_reasoning: FY26 return ratios are weak (ROCE ~9%, ROE ~6%) and the recovery is explicitly an FY27-28 story, yet the stock already trades at ~59x — no margin of safety and the catalyst is 2+ years out.
The wheelset/Europe optionality (Tatravagonka 10-yr pact, Lucchini RS) is real but immaterial before FY28, so it doesn't support a 10x-in-2-3-years tag now.
Legacy 108-screen 'excluded_large' call still holds under the no-ceiling thesis — 'neither' on size + deferred-catalyst grounds. Revisit as FY28 nears.

four_box.note: value_chain: domestic wheelset capacity is a genuine scarce/import-dependent node Jupiter is building (moat=yes); catalyst material only FY28+ (tam weak); '~59x, no margin of safety' (valuation=no).
